problem_statement: The WAIT_FOR macro evaluates its expression more times than it should. When the expression contains a side effect (e.g. incrementing a variable), WAIT_FOR invokes it an extra time after the polling loop has already observed it become true, producing an unexpected additional side effect. WAIT_FOR should evaluate the expression only as many times as the polling loop requires and then return the result of that final evaluation, without re-running the expression.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/lib/sys_util -s tests/lib/sys_util/libraries.sys_util -s libraries.sys_util -O twister-out --no-clean -W
